listing.name: Toy Story Racer — ToyStoryRacerRecomp (IraFunesto)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project describes a native racer preview with a native track renderer, widescreen and game-specific scene fixes. Portcove has not confirmed a full playthrough or every track and rendering enhancement. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 ToyStoryRacer PAL SLES-03398 Spanish/Italian/Dutch CUE/BIN; two known dump variants and guarded corrupt-track fixes are described upstream. First run creates local tsr_data; never redistribute it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The project describes a standalone release ZIP that extracts your own disc into tsr_data on first start, plus a PSXRecomp and launcher source build. The recorded review did not check package integrity. Permission to distribute the runtime and derived game code remains separate.

warnings: The project describes a native racer preview with a native track renderer, widescreen and game-specific scene fixes. Portcove has not confirmed a full playthrough or every track and rendering enhancement.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
